nermin.name: Nermin
nermin.place: İzmir agency office; occasional Istanbul appointments.
nermin.work: placement agency operator; formerly alterations tailor.
nermin.introduction: Nermin ran an alterations counter before she matched people to household work. Customers told her about unreliable nannies while waiting for a hem, and workers told her about households whose descriptions omitted the hardest part. The agency grew from the space between those accounts. She understands that a confident presentation and a trustworthy person are different things. She also knows how easily an agency can make uncertainty disappear from its paperwork simply because a client wants an answer before lunch.
nermin.role: placement agency operator; formerly alterations tailor.
nermin.family: A grown foster daughter lives independently.

hatice.name: Hatice
hatice.place: Istanbul tea garden; limited İzmir work exchange.
hatice.introduction: Hatice knows the difference between a garden that looks full and one that earns enough to open tomorrow. She counts cups while listening to the conversations that make people return. This has taught her a particular kind of hospitality: a chair can be offered without a demand that its occupant explain why they need it. She does not always meet her own standard. When business is slow she may encourage a discussion she knows will hurt someone who is absent, because leaving the table lively seems easier than letting it disperse.
hatice.family: Widowed; a grown child lives outside the district.

hulya.name: Hülya
hulya.place: İzmir after years in Antalya hotels.
hulya.work: oven cook; occasional catered placement worker.
hulya.introduction: Hülya has worked in kitchens where the staff meal was good only when a guest might see it. She remembers managers who spoke about family before asking for unpaid hours. Her reserve at the Pass is a practical test: does a promise become a rota, and does the rota survive a busy night? She does not need to become warmer to be valuable company. She does sometimes need to distinguish a new person's clumsy introduction from the familiar beginnings of exploitation.
hulya.role: oven cook; occasional catered placement worker.
hulya.family: Separated; an adult stepdaughter is a private background relation.

aylin.name: Aylin
aylin.place: Istanbul; short agency placements in İzmir.
aylin.work: school kitchen cook with occasional private meal work.
aylin.introduction: Aylin keeps a list on the refrigerator because she likes waking without renegotiating the whole day. She became the organised sister gradually: first remembering a school form, then a birthday, then the errand everyone assumed she would handle. Cooking gave that competence a wage and a recognizable endpoint. A hundred lunches served is evidence of work. A family that expects another quiet favour can consume the same effort without ever naming it. She loves Dilan and sometimes needs to stop organizing long enough to enjoy her.
aylin.role: school kitchen cook with occasional private meal work.
aylin.family: Dilan is her younger sister; their mother is background.

derya.name: Derya
derya.place: Flat 5, Lale Apartmanı, Istanbul; short relief lodging near the garden.
derya.introduction: Derya works nights because she likes a ward after the visitors have gone, when a patient may finally say what the daytime questions did not reach. This is a preference, not endless capacity. She comes home with sore feet and little patience for a drill in the stairwell. Neighbours often call her calm because they see her after she has already decided what needs doing. They do not see the effort it takes to stay gentle when someone mistakes her availability for a public resource.
derya.family: Single; Volkan is her brother, currently between jobs. His circumstances are private.

zeynep-pass.name: Zeynep
zeynep-pass.work: canteen cook; cold-station and daytime placement work.
zeynep-pass.introduction: Zeynep spent twenty years feeding schoolchildren before anyone called her an experienced cook. She knows which child will say that he has eaten when he has not, and which supplier will put the bruised vegetables at the bottom. Her skill grew from repetition under modest budgets. She dislikes the restaurant habit of praising a clever garnish while leaving the person washing trays outside the conversation. At the Pass she wants a reliable wage and a clean handover. She is interested in the customers, but does not want to become the kitchen's substitute mother.
zeynep-pass.role: canteen cook; cold-station and daytime placement work.
zeynep-pass.family: Two sons at home; no named spouse established.

selin-voice.name: Selin
selin-voice.place: City office and family home; father in an Anatolian town.
selin-voice.introduction: Selin is good at the part of office work where an unclear request must become something another person can finish. At home she applies that skill too quickly. When Halil speaks about the weather she hears the unscheduled appointment behind the sentence. When he says he has eaten she asks what. Their calls can become inspections because she is afraid that a relaxed call will miss the one warning that mattered. She also misses talking to her father about things that do not require either of them to improve.
selin-voice.family: Halil is her father. Her mother Nuran died before the Voice opening; her own household is unnamed.
